newsitem.title: USA: Gramm wins re-election to Senate from Texas.
newsitem.headline: Gramm wins re-election to Senate from Texas.

text.p: Texas Republican Sen. Phil Gramm won re-election Tuesday, defeating Democratic challenger Victor Morales, television networks reported.

Gramm outspent Morales, a school teacher who tried to run a grassroots campaign traveling around the state in a pickup truck. But Morales stumbled by offending several ethnic groups, for which he apologized. Gramm, who mounted an unsuccessful bid for the Republican presidential nomination, had both the name recognition and money to hold his seat.
